triage_reasoning: Multi-section portfolio with framer-motion scroll animations, glass morphism design system, smooth scroll providers, blob parallax, magnetic link physics, and 10 projects from JSON data. Not MICRO (has real state management, scroll-driven animations, multiple interactive components). Not COMPLEX (single-page composition, no micro-frontends, no complex routing).
